answer: One defence is Proof of unique device IMEI via manufacturer check: an IMEI verified with the maker, and the garden of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. Honest agents barely notice the check, because an IMEI verified with the maker is something they already have; the zenith falls entirely on the farm, which must buy or steal it a hundred times. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The yarrow grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
